title: The hypertrophy series: using mind muscle connection for tonnage quality control
summary: NH frames mind-muscle connection as quality control for tonnage: volume and intensity numbers alone do not guarantee the work reaches the target muscle. He uses MMC to quickly judge whether an exercise works, recounts how fixing his lat connection with pull-ups and pullovers made them grow, and discusses how exercise order affects which failure you hit.
claims: Mind-muscle connection is not just a pump; it is feeling the fibers stretch and contract in real time, and natural ability varies between muscles
Volume and intensity alone cannot guarantee tonnage reaches and grows the target muscle; MMC acts as quality control
A high-bar squat that turns into a good morning and one with thoracic extension pushing through the quads give the same tonnage number but load different muscles, and the former leads to injury
The best program is worthless if you cannot apply it in the gym in real time
Use MMC to quickly judge whether an exercise works instead of waiting four to six months to compare progress and measurements
A pump does not prove a muscle is working hard, and lacking a pump does not prove it is not
If you progress without feeling a connection, don't worry; build the connection when progress stalls
He believed he had bad lat insertions, but his lat tonnage was going to other back muscles; with MMC he found pull-ups and pullovers grow his lats
Data from your own body is the most valid and valuable; studies were not done with your body in mind
Once MMC shows a lift works, go back to the notebook to adjust rep range, intensity window or superset to fit the program
Following a supinated biceps movement with a triceps extension usually does not hurt either and can reduce elbow tendinitis
A wrist flexion exercise before biceps can destroy the ability to keep the wrist rigid, causing mechanical failure before the biceps reach muscular failure
Hypertrophy is simple but not easy; its concepts all interconnect
exercises: grew his lats once connection established
very efficient lat builder for him
